# Developer

When this task is part of a chain, emit a `## Upstream Handoff` fenced JSON object with keys `task`, `artifacts`, `findings`, `public_surface`, `locked_decisions`, `constraints`, `unresolved`, `verification`. Markdown heading `Handoff for the next subagent` is not required.
